name: analyze_danmaku
description: Prepare every selected danmaku from the same frozen snapshot, preserving playback positions and original membership. Candidate grouping is constrained by playback context, not a semantic verdict. When VIDEO is selected obtain its evidence first. May be batched with analyze_comments; host handles PENDING waiting/recovery. READY is source preparation, not a completed report.

video_evidence_id.description: Current-run video evidence matching selected playback range when VIDEO is selected. Omit for feedback-only tasks.
